corpus.family_policy: Linked meetings, translations and perturbations share a group and split.
corpus.source_policy: Synthetic content only; each source span carries fixture provenance.
corpus.freeze: Commit and hash protocol, corpus, prompt/label order, question grouping, frozen candidates, model/tokenizer/artifact revisions, precision, hardware and routing/privacy configuration before held-out inference.

budgets.live_execution: Only explicit evaluation configuration enables inference; credentials alone do not.
budgets.spend_policy: Reserve conservative per-request cost. Reconcile every attempt, repeated state and retry; halt subsequent paid work on unresolved cost or exhausted budget.

acceptance.scope: Every requirement is evaluated independently for en, nl and mixed; there is no universal winner from an average.
acceptance.unresolved_measurements: Missing model identity, evidence judgments, required metrics or resource measurements block adoption; they do not become zero or passing values.

metrics.ranking: nDCG@5 uses (2^grade-1)/log2(rank+1), grades 0..3. Recall treats any grade>0 as relevant. Candidate recall is measured before reranking. Unanswerable queries have undefined nDCG/recall and are reported separately.
metrics.classification: Abstentions count as uncovered and false negatives. Report per-class and macro/micro precision, recall and F1 alongside whole-set accuracy and accepted-label accuracy/coverage.
metrics.categorical_brier: Mean unnormalised sum over labels of (probability-one_hot_target)^2, range [0,2].
metrics.binary_brier: Mean (p_true-binary_target)^2, range [0,1], reported separately for true/false decisions.
metrics.ece: Top-label expected calibration error with 10 equal-width probability bins, using every probability-bearing case independently of abstention thresholds.
metrics.probability_policy: Only genuine typed class distributions support Brier/ECE and calibration. Provider confidence and relevance logits are retained as metadata, never relabelled as probabilities.
metrics.comparison: Paired bootstrap of equal-weight meeting-group means, 2000 replicates, seed 53, 95% percentile interval. Compare one language and split at a time.

calibration.context_policy: Bind the full ordered-label and identity/routing/privacy context by SHA-256; changes require refitting before a new held-out evaluation.
calibration.multiclass: One-parameter temperature scaling, mean NLL + 0.001*log(T)^2, T in [0.05,20].
calibration.binary: Monotone logistic calibration, mean binary NLL + 0.01*((slope-1)^2+intercept^2), slope in [0.001,20], intercept in [-20,20].
calibration.threshold: Choose the threshold maximizing calibration coverage at the task's required accepted-label precision. Abstain completely if none qualifies. Never fit on held-out rows.
calibration.small_sample: Report sample and meeting counts and flag fewer than 30 observations. One observed class retains identity calibration with an explicit warning.
calibration.label_variants: Keep ordered-label variants explicit and separate; do not select the best held-out order.

grounding_rubric.unit: An atomic factual claim plus its cited source spans.
grounding_rubric.supported: The cited source establishes every material part of the claim, including speaker, amount/date, polarity and final state after any retraction.
grounding_rubric.contradicted: A cited source conflicts with the claim, or a later explicit correction/retraction invalidates it.
grounding_rubric.insufficient: The source is related but does not establish the claim; a syntactically valid citation alone is insufficient.
grounding_rubric.unresolved: Store the raw synthetic prediction and a pending adjudication; exclude unresolved judgments from factual-support denominators, disclose their count and block adoption.
grounding_rubric.summary: Score factual/action/decision content against annotated evidence; checkbox or heading syntax alone does not establish event detection or support.
grounding_rubric.preservation: Keep original and final commitment status, owner identity, user notes and content language distinct from interface/template language.
grounding_rubric.adjudication: Store bilingual evidence judgments and rubric version alongside response hashes so offline replay regenerates the same report.

latency_sampling.panel: Use a fixed, hashed, task/language-stratified panel; quality cases run once per frozen configuration, latency repeats are accounted separately.
latency_sampling.local_cold: Only claim model-cold/load-time observations when the suite owns process and model startup; never unload or restart the user's services.
latency_sampling.hosted_cold: Client-cold request latency is not server/model-cold latency. Server load time and memory remain unmeasured unless independently supplied and clearly attributed.
latency_sampling.transport_separation: Report OpenRouter end-to-end, direct-provider and local latency separately. Do not estimate OpenRouter overhead by subtracting differing upstream measurements.

identity_and_privacy.hosted_preference: Prefer OpenRouter for the requested model/version and typed capability; use explicit direct configurations for unavailable combinations, with no runtime destination fallback.
identity_and_privacy.route_policy: Pin a model and specific supported upstream endpoint, disable provider/model fallbacks, retain the actual model/provider/request ID and routing configuration. Record any unavailable pinning or metadata.
identity_and_privacy.retention_region: Verify explicit route retention and processing-region requirements; never weaken requirements after rejection or treat a generic edge location as inference residency.
identity_and_privacy.checkpoint_policy: OpenRouter liquid/d1 and liquid/d1.1 and local LiquidAI/d1-2B remain distinct configurations unless exact checkpoint equivalence is proven.
identity_and_privacy.logging: Diagnostics contain IDs, timings, lengths and sanitized errors. Credentials and meeting/dictation content never enter diagnostic logs.

recommendations.policy: Recommend separately per task and language; adopting no new model is valid. A fixture, mock, inference run, package test, device test and deployment are distinct evidence.
production_gates: Chosen hosted route privacy/region and deployed configuration acceptance
recommendations.completion: Keep #53 open while required measurements, judgments, reproducibility or acceptance remain unmet.
